correctness.rationale: The dart model for the truncated cube has 24 vertices and 36 edges; its perfect matchings biject with odd-degree spanning subgraphs of Q3, giving 2^(12-7)=32 facets. Independently constructed 118096 faces, the complete vector (36,510,3492,11865,22920,28700,25176,15828,7040,2112,384,32), the ascending sequential 59036-pair Morse matching with one vertex plus 11 cells each in degrees 3 and 4, and acyclicity of all 118095 nonempty face vertices in the directed Hasse DAG. Reconstructed the oriented 11x11 gradient-path matrix and found determinant -1 (the prose reports +1, an orientation-sign discrepancy); its absolute determinant one is the required condition. With no cells in dimensions one or two, the Morse CW model is simply connected and Z-acyclic; Whitehead yields contractibility. Euler of ordinary matching complex -331 is consistent with separately published full ordinary-complex calculation. This is complete finite enumeration of the specified graph, not extrapolation.
